music.name: SQUISH — Year Anniversary
music.why: Massive Dore Alley Friday headliner — 348 RA interested, Sleep D live set and Two Shell in the same night, 8 hours across The Great Northern
music.summary: SQUISH celebrates its anniversary at The Great Northern on Friday July 24, 8pm–4am, $30–50. One of the most-anticipated SF club nights of the summer, stacking Sleep D (live), Two Shell, PLO Man, SAMO (JP), Club Moniker (llloyd + suade + ryan oh), Just Another Bitch, Manuka Honey, TWINS ONLINE, 1tbsp and Wonja. 21+.

music.name: Bassnectar: The Homecoming Show + Dead Prez
music.why: Bassnectar's rare hometown arena return with dead prez, relocated after its original San Jose venue fell through
music.summary: Bassnectar headlines his hometown Homecoming Show with support from dead prez at PETE BE Center in San Jose, Saturday July 25, doors 3pm.

music.name: Phreak Out: Free Day Party BBQ
music.why: Free outdoor waterfront BBQ party with skyline views, ideal for an all-day hang
music.summary: Phreak Out throws a free outdoor day party and BBQ at Middle Harbor Shoreline Park on Oakland's waterfront, Saturday July 25 from noon to 7pm, with open bay and skyline views, all ages welcome, no cover.

music.name: GRUNT: Dore Saturday
music.why: The Stud's flagship Dore Alley night — leather, sweat, Faited and MS.SMITH; 96 RA interested puts it in the top tier for the weekend
music.summary: GRUNT: Dore Saturday at The Stud on July 25, 9pm–2am, $20. The Stud's leather/queer club night for Up Your Alley weekend, with DJs Faited and MS.SMITH bringing dark electronics and industrial-tinged house to SoMa's most storied queer bar. 21+.

music.name: Up Your Alley / Dore Alley Street Fair & Fetish Festival
music.address: Dore Alley & Folsom St, San Francisco, CA 94103
music.why: SF's grittier, more local leather fair — no ticket, just a suggested donation at the gate
music.summary: The annual Up Your Alley street fair takes over Dore Alley and Folsom Street in SoMa with leather and fetish gear vendors, DJs, gogo dancers, and kink performers. Produced by the nonprofit Folsom Street, it draws roughly 10,000–15,000 attendees as the smaller, more local sibling of September's Folsom Street Fair.

music.name: Mostly Cloudy: Leonce + Syd
music.why: Mostly Cloudy at Monarch stacks an unusually good Saturday bill — Leonce and Syd are exactly the kind of act this room was made for, and the series itself (run by QUEENIE) is one of SF's most distinctive electronic nights
music.summary: Mostly Cloudy presents Leonce + Syd at Monarch on Saturday July 25, 10pm–3am. The recurring Bay Area party series celebrates Black electronic music — ghetto tech, Miami bass, baile funk and Chicago house — with QUEENIE, Casamiento, mymy and Afakasi Papi rounding out the bill. 21+.

music.name: Club Estrus: Dore Alley Afterparty w/ Jasmine Infiniti, Mr. Gizmoe, Mister Hoochiemama, Papa Xanny
music.why: Raw queer bass and techno afterparty capping off the whole Dore Alley weekend's energy.
music.summary: Club Estrus throws a Dore Alley afterparty at The Stud in San Francisco on Sunday, July 26, from 9pm-2am. Tickets run $11.50-28.75 on a notaflof (no one turned away for lack of funds) basis, 21+.

music.name: Sunset Dance Party
music.why: A free POC/female-led sunset rave on the sand at Ocean Beach — RA-ticketed but no cost, with the exact meetup spot dropped day-of.
music.summary: Sunset Dance Party from No Reason SF, a free sunset rave on the sand at Ocean Beach, Saturday July 25, 3–9pm. Free tickets via Resident Advisor; the precise spot is released day-of. POC- and female-DJ-forward Bay Area crew.

music.name: Alchemy SF: Genix, Jaytech, Kristina Sky
music.why: Longest runtime of the night (until 4am) with a headline-caliber progressive/trance lineup, the priciest ticket too, and the queer-trance counterpoint to Dore Alley weekend's usual sound
music.summary: Alchemy SF brings its queer trance and progressive house party to Public Works for the first time, opening night of Dore Alley Weekend, headlined by Genix with Jaytech and Kristina Sky, Friday July 24 from 9pm-4am. Tickets $43-62.

music.name: Perreoland - The Ultimate Reggaeton Experience
music.why: Dedicated reggaeton dance floor for Latin-music fans wanting a full night of perreo
music.summary: Perreoland brings an all-reggaeton dance night to The Midway's warehouse space, Saturday July 25 from 9pm to 2am, tickets $15–50.

music.name: ROMP T-Dance: ROMP 69 – The Dirty Discotheque
music.why: Official closing tea dance of Dore Alley weekend, resident DJ spins a seven-hour disco set
music.summary: ROMP T-Dance closes out Dore Alley Weekend with a seven-hour disco-themed set from resident DJ Russ Rich, backed by lasers from RAGERLAZER and visuals from VJ Blanket. The 21+ event enforces a leather/latex/rubber/fetish/glitter dress code and benefits Folsom Street and the Grass Roots Gay Rights Foundation.

music.name: Stamina Sundays
music.why: SF's longest-running weekly drum & bass night, free every Sunday deep into the night.
music.summary: Stamina Sundays is F8's weekly drum & bass and jungle residency, running free every Sunday from 10pm to 2am at the Folsom Street club. On July 26, 2026 the resident Stamina DNB collective keeps the 21+ floor moving with rotating DJs and hosts.

music.name: Afro Thursdays feat. Nile, Kamu Kamu, Aura, Juan.g
music.why: Free-before-11-RSVP afrobeat night on a proper SoMa club sound system, dance-forward crowd.
music.summary: Afro Thursdays afro-house night with Nile, Kamu Kamu, Aura, and Juan.g at F8 in SoMa, San Francisco, Thursday July 23 from 9pm to 2am. Free with RSVP before 11pm, $10 after.

music.name: Kausmic: Syd Gris, Emanate, JXM b2b DNEB, JustJovani, Miss Liv
music.why: Free-before-10pm entry rewards early arrivals wanting a long house marathon till 3am
music.summary: Kausmic stacks five house DJs led by Syd Gris at The Great Northern in SoMa, Saturday July 25 from 9:30pm to 3am, free with RSVP before 10pm, then $14.40–31, 21+.

music.name: Jody Wisternoff & Nox Vahn (All Night Long)
music.why: Jody Wisternoff and Nox Vahn going b2b all night — two progressive house veterans holding Audio SF for a full run
music.summary: Jody Wisternoff and Nox Vahn play all night long at Audio SF on Friday July 24, 9:30pm–2am. A melodic, progressive house standout with two names who've helped define the form. 21+.

music.name: Soul Clap
music.why: Soul Clap's Dore Alley Saturday at Audio — house with roots in classic soul and disco, always a proper dance experience
music.summary: Soul Clap plays the Dore Alley Saturday slot at Audio SF on July 25, 9:30pm–2am. The Boston duo's blend of classic house, disco and deep funk makes this one of the weekend's more reliable dancefloors. 21+.

music.name: Sam Feldt (Day Party)
music.why: Rare afternoon slot from a festival-circuit headliner — a chance to catch Sam Feldt in a small club instead of a field
music.summary: Dutch dance/pop producer Sam Feldt plays a daytime set at Audio SF on Saturday July 25, 2pm–7pm. Polished melodic house and feel-good electronics, in the intimacy of an 11th Street club. 21+.

music.name: Avision, Joey Trip, FELINE, Anderson Bourne
music.why: SoMa warehouse-club night for serious dancers wanting a proper sound system
music.summary: Avision, Joey Trip, FELINE and Anderson Bourne headline a night at Public Works, SF's SoMa warehouse club, Saturday July 25 from 9pm to 2am, tickets $28.75, 21+.

music.name: Bad Bunny Night
music.why: A dedicated all-Bad-Bunny reggaeton floor with the resident DJ duo who run this series
music.summary: DNA Lounge's recurring Bad Bunny Night returns Saturday July 25 with twin DJ duo OtebNSolrac spinning reggaeton and Latin house from 9pm to 2am, tickets $10-22, 21+.

music.name: Bassedelic Weekender
music.why: Church of Drum & Bass's heavyweight Oakland dancefloor night, five-deep DnB lineup running to 1am
music.summary: Bassedelic Weekender's Saturday night, "Bassedelic Baptism," hits Hella Bees in downtown Oakland July 25 from 7pm-1am (21+), a heavyweight drum & bass dancefloor set from Church of Drum & Bass with Thug Shells, Dumbsteppaz, Naste, Luna Assassin and PLC. Part of a two-day weekender with a $20 weekender pass and a $75 VIP experience tier.

music.name: Camp Priceless 2026
music.why: 20th-anniversary underground electronic camping festival deep in the Mendocino redwoods, four days
music.summary: Now in its 20th year, Priceless is a multi-day underground electronic and live music camping festival at Camp Navarro in Mendocino County, July 23–26, spread across Meadow, Lodge and Redwood stages plus a nightly silent disco.

music.name: Chunk Dore Alley Feat. Bears In Space, Dicap, Nick Moss, Thckrtanker, Omnibot
music.why: Premier bear/cub Saturday main event of Dore Alley weekend, three rooms at F8 with Bears In Space DJs and go-go bears
music.summary: CHUNK SF presents Bears In Space at F8 for Dore Alley weekend, Saturday July 25 from 10pm to 4am, with DJs Dicap, Nick Moss, Thckrtanker and Omnibot across three rooms, go-go bears and hosts Ross and Big Claude. Tier 3 GA $60, 21+.

music.name: Days Like This
music.why: Free lakeside dance party at golden hour, the rare no-cover outdoor option this Friday
music.summary: Days Like This is a free outdoor house music gathering at the Lake Merritt Pergola in Oakland, Friday July 24 from 5:30-9:30pm, running through sunset by the lake.

music.name: Death Guild
music.why: World's longest-running weekly goth night, cheap door, 18+, two rooms all night
music.summary: Death Guild, the world's oldest weekly goth/industrial dance night, takes over DNA Lounge on Monday July 20. Six DJs in two rooms — gothic, industrial, synthpop, noise, and ambient — 9:30pm to 2:30am, 18+, $5 before 10:30pm.

music.name: Magit Cacoon, Moheato, Abluebird
music.why: Techno-leaning back-to-back night for heads who prefer deeper, darker sounds till 4am
music.summary: Magit Cacoon, Moheato and Abluebird bring a techno-leaning set to Halcyon in SoMa, Saturday July 25 from 10pm to 4am, tickets $12–30, 21+.

music.name: Niiko X Swae
music.why: LA house duo behind the viral Tiesto/Tears for Fears crossover brings pop-house hooks to a Midway warehouse night
music.summary: Niiko X Swae, the LA house duo known for their viral collaboration with Tiesto and Tears For Fears, headline The Midway's warehouse room Saturday July 25 from 9pm to 2am.

music.name: Party Pupils X Goshfather - Disco House Vs. Yacht House
music.why: Sunset day party split between disco grooves and yacht-rock house on a big warehouse patio
music.summary: Party Pupils and Goshfather split The Midway's warehouse and outdoor patio into disco house vs. yacht house rooms, Saturday July 25 from 2pm to 8pm, tickets $30, 21+.

music.name: Rhythm in the Sky
music.why: Free rooftop R&B at golden hour — rare weeknight open-air escape downtown
music.summary: DJ Heartbreak's weekly rooftop R&B residency at Timbri Hotel, every Wednesday 5–9pm. Free entry, 21+, golden-hour views over downtown SF.

music.name: Sindustry Sundays: Alexx Gold, Jeff Straw
music.why: Free-cover Sunday house tradition at Butter with cheap drinks and a rotating guest DJ.
music.summary: Sindustry Sundays returns to Butter in San Francisco on Sunday, July 26, with resident DJ/saxophonist Jeff Straw joined by guest DJ Alexx Gold, 9pm-2am. No cover, $5 suggested donation, cheap drinks, 21+.

music.name: Until We Meet Again | Open Air: Suanni, NickV
music.why: Free outdoor techno under open sky, a rare no-cover option for early Sunday arrivals.
music.summary: Until We Meet Again presents an open-air techno set with Suanni and NickV at a TBA San Francisco location on Sunday, July 26, from 1pm-6pm. Entry is free with RSVP or $10-25 at the door, 21+.

music.name: TUFF: Dore Alley Weekend Kickoff
music.why: The official kickoff to Dore Alley weekend at 1015 — sets the tone for SoMa's leather-and-dance weekend before the street fair
music.summary: TUFF hosts the Dore Alley Weekend Kickoff at 1015 Folsom on Thursday July 23, 9pm–3am, $25–35. The unofficial opener to San Francisco's annual Up Your Alley leather/kink street fair weekend. 21+.

music.name: Planet Synth 4th Anniversary Feat. Facets
music.why: Four-year anniversary party in Monarch's main room, built as a bigger celebration than a standard weekly
music.summary: Planet Synth celebrates its 4th anniversary featuring Facets at Monarch's main room in San Francisco, Friday July 24 from 9pm-2am. Tickets $14.40-25.45.

music.name: Secret Psychedelica: LION HEART with Aktyum
music.why: Public Works' Saturday psychedelic club night during Dore weekend — sliding-scale door makes it the accessible option in an expensive weekend
music.summary: Secret Psychedelica brings LION HEART with Aktyum to Public Works on Saturday July 25, 9pm–2am, $5–25 sliding scale. Techno and deep house across two floors, with MOHARI, Elegie, KAARI, AXL PUERTO and Michael Liu. 21+.

music.name: DORE Weekend: Freaky Emo, Infinite Jess, Alice Stribling
music.why: Dore Alley weekend techno party in a gritty Haight underground room, kink-friendly crowd.
music.summary: DORE Weekend techno party featuring Freaky Emo, Infinite Jess, and Alice Stribling at Underground SF on Haight Street, Thursday July 23 at 9pm. $10 cover, kicking off the Dore Alley leather weekend.

music.name: Let's Go Disco w/ Elado
music.why: Cheap all-night disco residency for dancers who want groove over bass
music.summary: Let's Go Disco's weekly residency with Elado hits Madrone Art Bar on Divisadero, Saturday July 25 from 9:30pm to 2am, tickets $10, 21+.

music.name: ANIMERAVE.EXE
music.address: 12 N San Pedro St, San Jose, CA 95110
music.why: Anime-themed rave for cosplay-friendly crowds wanting a South Bay niche night
music.summary: ANIMERAVE.EXE brings a cosplay-friendly anime rave to Blanco Urban in downtown San Jose, Saturday July 25 from 8pm to 1am, tickets $25–35.

music.name: Big Muscle Party: Uya Edition
music.why: Bare Chest Calendar's official launch, a daytime muscle/bear circuit party during Up Your Alley weekend
music.summary: Big Muscle Party: UYA Edition is the official Bare Chest Calendar launch party at DNA Lounge during Up Your Alley weekend, with DJ sets from Paul Goodyear, Aki Above DNA and Giovanni Sainz, 2pm–7pm, 21+.

music.name: Blade Rave - The Ritz
music.why: Vampire-themed Bloodrave takeover of San Jose's biggest dedicated nightclub, with a hard-techno/industrial/goth soundtrack
music.summary: Blade Rave turns The Ritz in San Jose's SOFA district into a vampire-themed Bloodrave for one night on Friday, July 24 at 9pm, spanning hard techno, techno, industrial, rave and goth sounds; 21+.

music.name: Body SF Soma
music.why: Low-cost SoMa wine-bar rave for a crowd wanting something cheap and packed
music.summary: Body SF Soma turns JAX Vineyards' SoMa tasting room into a dance party, Saturday July 25 from 8pm to 2am, entry just $10, 21+.

music.name: Brews Crew S2E4
music.why: Free all-day bass/dubstep soundsystem set from six DJs, BYOB — note the listing says it relocated to Lake Merritt
music.summary: Flowstate Soundsystem's Brews Crew S2E4 lineup — Gisaza, Oldgold, Khariszma, Chronique, Flaco and Singe — plays a free BYOB day party Saturday July 25 from 4-10pm; per a late update on the event page, the venue moved from The Rake at Admiral Maltings to Lake Merritt in Oakland.

music.name: Daxson
music.why: South Bay bottle-service nightclub crowd wanting a mainstream late-night dance floor
music.summary: Daxson plays live at Aura Nightclub in downtown San Jose, Saturday July 25 starting 9:30pm, tickets from $10, 21+.

music.name: Deb Bailar Mas Perreo (Bad Bunny Dance Night)
music.why: All-Bad-Bunny reggaeton dance night for fans who want the hits over underground DJ sets
music.summary: Deb Bailar Mas Perreo is a Bad Bunny-themed reggaeton and Latin dance night at The Midway in San Francisco, Friday July 24 from 10pm-2am. Tickets $19-31.

music.name: Deviants Adult Arcade: Up Your Alley Afterparty
music.why: Folsom Street's own multi-room afterparty inside the historic Old Mint building
music.summary: Folsom Street's official Up Your Alley afterparty takes over two floors of the Old Mint with stage takeovers by BOOF and Hot Goth GF, DJs, interactive installations, and live performances. 21+.

music.name: Dirtwire, Savej, Thug Shells
music.why: Live instrumentation over bass production in the Midway's 888 Garage room, a rootsier alternative to straight DJ sets
music.summary: Dirtwire headlines a live bass/electronic show with Savej and Thug Shells at The Midway's 888 Garage in San Francisco, Friday July 24 from 8pm-2am. Tickets $30-35.

music.name: DiscoTech
music.why: Sweaty disco-house set on F8's dialed-in sound system, cheap late-night SoMa dance fix.
music.summary: DiscoTech disco-house DJ night at F8 in SoMa, San Francisco, Thursday July 23 from 10pm to 2am. Cover $5 to $10, late-night club setting.

music.name: Kyle Walker, Kenny Cordeiro, Cris Rocks
music.why: Late-night house residency for dancers wanting a proper sound system past 4am
music.summary: Kyle Walker, Kenny Cordeiro and Cris Rocks play Halcyon in SoMa, Saturday July 25 from 10pm to 4am, tickets $12–30, 21+.

music.name: MOVEMENT Ecstatic Dance SF // Medicine Music
music.why: Substance-free sacred-space dance journey with meditation and sound bath, no shoes allowed
music.summary: A substance-free ecstatic dance journey mixed live by DJ Medicine Music at Sacred Heart Church (of 8 Wheels), opening with creative movement and meditation and closing with a sound bath in a shoe-free, sliding-scale-donation space.

music.name: Nightbreed: Horror Rave
music.why: Summerween horror-rave installment with red lighting and horror visuals all night, 18+
music.summary: The second installment of DNA Lounge's Summerween series, Nightbreed: Horror Rave pairs darkwave, industrial, synth and EBM sets from Sage, Melting Girl and Boblivion with red lighting and horror visuals; 18+, 9:30pm–2am.

music.name: No Basic: Octane
music.why: RSVP-only midweek room where each edition is built around one iconic album given a live re-arrangement mid-party; taste-driven, style-forward crowd in a tucked-away Chinatown space
music.summary: No Basic returns to Lion's Den in Chinatown on Wednesday July 22 with resident DJs BAZZ and Jay Neal. Each week the party is guided by an iconic album — this edition gives 'Octane' its moment, a curated set arranged within the night. Doors 10:30pm, 21+, RSVP for the address.

music.name: SF Buddhist Church's 95th Bon Odori Street Dance Festival
music.why: 95th year of one of the oldest, largest Obon dance festivals in the US
music.summary: Community members dance in a circle to taiko drums and folk songs during this traditional Buddhist summer festival on Octavia Street, alongside the church's 83rd Ginza Bazaar food and craft stalls the day before.

music.name: SOMA Nights: Sidewalk Gallery
music.why: A free SOMa block party turned pop-up art gallery in a hidden Folsom alleyway, with a street-level DJ takeover and no cover.
music.summary: SOMA Nights: Sidewalk Gallery is a free (RSVP) block party on Thursday July 23, 5–8:30pm, in a hidden Folsom Street alleyway near 1145 Folsom. Quit Your Day Job and SoMa West CBD turn the alley into a pop-up outdoor gallery for about a dozen local part-time artists, with a street-level DJ takeover alongside.
music.promoter: SoMa Nights (Quit Your Day Job x SoMa West CBD)

music.name: Sxtps: Dore w/DJ Kidd, Charles Hawthorne
music.why: Dore Alley Weekend leather/queer party centering Black and Brown Queer and Trans nightlife, the kickoff night for SF's biggest fetish weekend
music.summary: SXTPS: Dore, a body- and sex-positive dance party for Black and Brown Queer and Trans people during Dore Alley Weekend, with DJ Kidd in the main room and Charles Hawthorne in the Dazzle Room, spinning House, Techno, Hip Hop, Disco and Jersey Club. DNA Lounge, Friday July 24, 10pm-2:30am, 21+.

music.name: Upward
music.why: Sunrise-to-noon rave energy for people who'd rather dance through daylight than midnight.
music.summary: Upward is a long-running Sunday morning dance party at Monroe in San Francisco's North Beach, running 6am-noon, 21+, with $20 tickets for this sunrise-to-noon rave format.

music.name: GENERAIDERZ x NO BIAS: Summer of Wub
music.why: Bass-heavy Dore Alley Friday alternative — GENERAIDERZ and NO BIAS bringing wubs to F8 while the rest of SoMa goes house
music.summary: GENERAIDERZ x NO BIAS: Summer of Wub at F8 on Friday July 24, 10pm–3am, $10–20. Bass music, dubstep and wub-forward club sounds at 1192 Folsom, 21+.

music.name: GROSSOMODDO: Mediterranean Afro House
music.why: Mediterranean and African rhythms in the Madarae basement — the sleeper pick for the weekend if big rooms feel too crowded
music.summary: GROSSOMODDO brings Mediterranean Afro House to Madarae SF (46 Minna St) on Saturday July 25, 9pm–3am. Percussive, sun-drenched African and Mediterranean house sounds in an intimate basement setting, 21+.

music.name: nina sol & Friends
music.why: Free secret-bar backroom set for those who like discovering hidden Oakland spots
music.summary: nina sol & Friends play a free set at Moonglow, the secret backroom bar inside Gold Palm in downtown Oakland, Saturday July 25 from 9pm to midnight.

music.name: Feelmore Sunday: Mr. V
music.why: Cozy Fillmore lounge session for winding down Sunday with deep house and no cover.

music.name: House Rules: DJ Kirill, Miss Gigi

music.summary: House Rules house music night with DJ Kirill and Miss Gigi at F8 in SoMa, San Francisco, Thursday July 23 from 10pm to 2am. No cover listed, late-night club setting.

music.name: 2016 Summer Rave: eviemoon, djfaded, IHaveaBomb, gemstonebullets, 3bveritas
music.why: 2016 throwback theme with a secret address revealed near showtime, for the DIY warehouse crowd
music.summary: 2016 Summer Rave features eviemoon, djfaded, IHaveaBomb, gemstonebullets and 3bveritas at a TBA Oakland location, Friday July 24 from 9:30pm-3:30am. $15 presale, $20 at door.

music.name: Aida, Heavens No, Jimmy B
music.why: Free daytime coffee-shop set for anyone easing into the weekend slow
music.summary: Aida, Heavens No, and Jimmy B play a free daytime DJ set at Hedge Coffee in the Mission, Saturday July 25 from 11am to 5pm, a casual coffee-shop hang with no cover.

music.name: Amal Nemer, Santi, Joseph Mitchelle, Medrvno, Lee Jones, Techdelic
music.why: Six-DJ lineup runs latest of the night until 3am in a boutique Financial District lounge
music.summary: A six-DJ bill including Amal Nemer, Santi, Joseph Mitchelle, Medrvno, Lee Jones and Techdelic plays Madarae, a boutique lounge in San Francisco's Financial District, Friday July 24 from 9pm-3am. Early RSVP $10, otherwise $12-23+.

music.name: Chef Frodow
music.why: Free natural-wine listening-room set for an intimate, low-key SF night
music.summary: Chef Frodow DJs a free set at Phonobar, San Francisco's natural-wine listening room near Civic Center, Saturday July 25 from 8:30pm to 1:30am, no cover.

music.name: Club Caffeinated - Flow Jam

music.summary: Club Caffeinated hosts a Flow Jam afternoon dance session at Continental Club in downtown Oakland, Saturday July 25 from 2pm to 8pm, an early alternative to the late-night circuit.

music.summary: Dali headlines with Izik and Gilarden at Halcyon, an immersive electronic music venue in SoMa, San Francisco, Friday July 24 starting at 10pm. $12 before 11pm, $19-30 after.

music.summary: Dani Thorne, Equalizer, Seso and Miza play The Rink Studios community venue in Sacramento, Saturday July 25 from 9pm to 1:30am, tickets $23.54.

music.name: Eclypse EDM Haus: Sampphire, Mutt, Powell Ranger

music.summary: Eclypse EDM Haus underground bass rave featuring Sampphire, Mutt, and Powell Ranger at 705 Lounge in downtown Sacramento, Thursday July 23 from 10:30pm to 1:30am. Tickets $19.99.

music.name: Fiat Panda, Petre, Big Wink

music.summary: Fiat Panda, Petre and Big Wink spin an Italo disco night at Thee Stork Club, Oakland's KONO dive-bar venue, Saturday July 25 starting 9pm, tickets $10.

music.name: Fromclay + Thatfranco

music.summary: Fromclay and Thatfranco play Eria Marina, an event venue in SF's Marina District, Saturday July 25 from 9:30pm to 1:30am, tickets $17.85–28.52.

music.name: Hard Reset
